title: A survey of diversity quantification in natural language processing: The why, what, where and how

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review analyzing how NLP papers quantify meta-linguistic diversity, evaluating the representation of different languages, language families, and typological properties to mitigate English-centric bias.
Systematic literature review of NLP papers to assess how cultural diversity is operationalized as a metric to ensure datasets and systems fairly account for and represent diverse cultures.

Systematic literature review identifying how NLP studies measure the diversity of text producers and annotators, tracking meta-linguistic variables such as the racial identity of language signers, political opinions of authors, and diverse annotator perspectives.
